title: winch2: tests for resolution, inheritance, capabilities, generation
description:
Add automated tests for the new paradigm under tests/. See doc/winch2-plan.md section 12 and existing tests/test_util.py, tests/test_podman.py for style.

Cover: paradigm detection and mixed-config error; recipe_base stack concatenation and last-wins variable precedence incl. --set; cycle detection; FROM injection vs containerfile escape hatch; digest image naming (deterministic + prefix dedup across recipes); unresolved-markup error; capability validation (exact match, '|' OR, multi-entry AND, failure message). An integration-style test of 'winch recipe --stack ...' that stops short of invoking podman (or mocks it). Depends on instance generation and capability validation; extend as recipe/list commands land.

Acceptance: tests pass and exercise each behavior above.

title: winch2: 'winch recipe' build command with --stack/--set and image labels
description:
Add the 'winch recipe' command, the build analog for the new paradigm. See doc/winch2-plan.md sections 12.5, 12.8, 12.9.

Signature: winch recipe [NAME] [--stack a,b,c] [--set L.V=val]... plus the existing build options (rebuild/force/outpath/containerfile-attribute/image-attribute). Exactly one of NAME or --stack required. --set is repeatable, highest precedence. Resolve recipe -> validate capabilities -> generate instance chain -> reuse the existing rebuild/force/outpath/podman build machinery (share code with old build where practical), passing the winch.* image labels from the labeling task. Error clearly if invoked on an old-paradigm config. Touches cli.py. Depends on instance generation, capability validation, and podman labeling.

Acceptance: 'winch recipe phlex-debian' and 'winch recipe --stack debian,spack --set debian.release=trixie' build the expected ordered images with labels; capability failures abort before podman runs.
notes:
Landed in src/winch/cli.py (recipe command + _build_inodes refactor) + recipe.formatted_provides; tests in tests/test_recipe_cmd.py (8, podman stubbed via monkeypatch).

Command: winch recipe [NAME] [--stack a,b,c] [--set LAYER.VAR=VALUE]... [-r/--rebuild] [-f/--force] [-o/--outpath] [--containerfile-attribute] [--image-attribute] [extra podman args].
- Exactly one of NAME or --stack (errors on both/neither). --set repeatable, highest precedence.
- Flow: parse_set_overrides -> resolve_recipe -> validate_capabilities (BEFORE any podman) -> generate_instances -> build chain in dependency order (graph.ipath of the single leaf).
- Each built image gets winch.* labels via label_args(instance_labels(inode, idata, formatted_provides(layer, vars))).
- Default outpath: winch-contexts/{kind}-{node}/Containerfile.
- Errors clearly on old-paradigm config.

Refactor: the old 'build' command body was extracted into module-level _build_inodes(graph, inodes, containerfile_attribute, image_attribute, rebuild, force, outpath, args, labels_for=None). Both 'build' (labels_for=None) and 'recipe' (labels_for set) share it. force/rebuild 'last'/'deps' semantics use inodes[-1] as the leaf.

recipe.formatted_provides(layer, variables) = self-formatted provides (public wrapper over _resolve_caps).

For winch-bea (list/dot/render): use Main.recipe_graph(name=,stack=,sets=,validate=False) which already supports union-of-all-named-recipes when no selector given.
close_reason: Implemented 'winch recipe' build command (NAME/--stack/--set, capability validation before podman, winch.* labels) sharing _build_inodes with old build; 8 tests, old path verified intact.

title: winch2: capability (provides/requires) accumulation and validation
description:
Validate capability compatibility over a resolved stack before any podman call. See doc/winch2-plan.md section 12.6.

Walk the stack base->top accumulating the union of provides into a set 'avail'. For each layer, every requires entry must be satisfied by avail: a no-'|' entry is satisfied by exact membership; a '|' entry is an OR alternation (any alternative in avail); AND across entries. A layer's own provides are added to avail AFTER its requires are checked. provides/requires are self_format-ed before comparison (may reference layer vars). On failure emit a clear error naming recipe, layer, unmet requirement, and the available set; do not build. Depends on recipe resolution.

Acceptance: compatible stacks pass; an incompatible stack (e.g. a debian-requiring layer on an alma base) fails with a precise message; '|' OR and multi-entry AND behave per spec.
notes:
Landed in src/winch/recipe.py + cli.Main.recipe_graph; tests in tests/test_capabilities.py (14).

Public API for winch-xm4 (build) and winch-bea (list/dot/render):
- recipe.validate_capabilities(layers, resolved) -> set of all provided capabilities. Walks resolved.stack base->top; for each layer, every requires entry must be satisfied by the avail set accumulated from layers BELOW it (a layer's own provides are added AFTER its requires are checked). '|' = OR within an entry; AND across entries. Raises ConfigError naming recipe, layer, unmet requirement, and sorted(avail) on failure.
- provides/requires are self-formatted against the layer's resolved (raw) vars via recipe._resolve_caps (fixpoint, so chained vars like spec='{package}@{version}' and 'pkg:gcc@{version}' resolve). They live on Layer.provides/.requires (NOT in idata).
- cli.Main.recipe_graph(name=, stack=, sets=, validate=True): build command should use the default validate=True; list/dot may pass validate=False to view incompatible stacks. Errors surface as click.ClickException.

Capabilities are build-IRRELEVANT metadata (not in the content digest); for image labels (winch-xm4 / section 12.8) read provides from layers[name].provides and self-format if needed (recipe._resolve_caps available).
close_reason: Implemented capability validation (exact match, '|' OR alternation, multi-entry AND, self-formatted caps); wired optional validation into Main.recipe_graph; 14 tests + integration verified.

title: winch2: instance-chain generation with FROM injection, digest naming, resolution check
description:
Generate the linear instance chain for a resolved recipe and feed the existing networkx I-graph (Graph.I). See doc/winch2-plan.md sections 12.2, 12.7.

For each layer in stack order: build idata from layer defaults merged with the recipe's resolved overrides for that layer; set kind=<layer>; attach parent=<previous instance idata> (empty for base). If layer has body and no containerfile, set containerfile='FROM {parent[image]}\n'+body. Run util.self_format. Compute digest over idata with the 'image' key EXCLUDED (so the name doesn't feed its own hash; parent[image] already chains the digest downward). Set image='localhost/winch/<layer>:<digest12>' (deterministic, collision-stable) unless author set image explicitly. Use the same content digest as the I-graph node id so identical stack prefixes across recipes dedupe.

Add a 'find unresolved {markup}' scanner (util.py) and run it after self_format: any remaining markup in a buildable layer is a hard error naming layer+key. Keep old Graph.initialize intact; branch on paradigm. Depends on recipe resolution.

Acceptance: a resolved recipe produces an ordered I-node chain with injected FROM, deterministic digest image names, working {parent[...]} interpolation, prefix dedup across recipes, and a clear error on unresolved markup.
notes:
Landed in src/winch/graph.py (generation) + src/winch/util.py (find_unresolved) + cli.Main.recipe_graph; tests in tests/test_generate.py (13) + test_util coverage via test_generate.

Public API for winch-ych (capabilities), winch-xm4 (build), winch-bea (list/dot/render):
- graph.generate_instances(layers, resolved_recipes, graph=None) -> Graph with .I (networkx DiGraph) populated by deduped instance chains. Reuses Graph.ipath/from_kind/data; node id = content digest.
- graph.build_instance(layer, variables, parent_idata) -> unformatted idata.
- graph._content_digest(idata) = digest over idata EXCLUDING 'image'; this is the I-node id. Image auto-name = f'{WINCH_IMAGE_PREFIX}/{layer}:{inode[:WINCH_IMAGE_DIGEST_LEN]}' (localhost/winch/<layer>:<12hex>) unless layer vars set an explicit 'image'.
- I-node idata keys: resolved layer vars, kind, parent (full parent idata dict incl parent image), containerfile (synthesized 'FROM {parent[image]}\n'+body, or verbatim escape-hatch), image. provides/requires are NOT in idata (build-irrelevant metadata; excluded so digest reflects build content) -> capability task must read them from layers[name].provides/.requires.
- util.find_unresolved(originals, namespace) -> {field: [missing refs]}. Detects genuinely-missing fields without false-positiving on shell ${{VAR}} escaped braces (formats each ORIGINAL once with escapes intact).
- cli.Main.recipe_graph(name=None, stack=None, sets=None) -> Graph. No selector = union of all named recipes (deduped). Raises ClickException on old-paradigm config or ConfigError.

Resolution check raises ConfigError naming recipe+layer+unresolved refs; a base layer using body (no parent) correctly errors on unresolved {parent[image]}.
close_reason: Implemented instance-chain generation: FROM injection, digest image naming, prefix dedup, escape-safe resolution check; 13 tests + end-to-end verified.

title: winch2: config paradigm detection and layer/recipe parsing
description:
Implement detection of the new winch paradigm and parsing of its tables. See doc/winch2-plan.md sections 12.1-12.3.

After load_many/merge, classify the config: NEW if any table is under the 'layer' or 'recipe' top-level namespace; OLD otherwise. A config mixing [layer.*]/[recipe.*] with old-style bare parent_kind tables is an error (fail fast, clear message).

Parse [layer.NAME] tables (default variables as string scalars; provides/requires lists; body and/or containerfile) and [recipe.NAME] tables (stack list, recipe_base string-or-list, and layer-qualified variables like 'spack.version' which TOML nests as {spack:{version:..}}). Reject non-capability list-valued layer params as errors. Provide a normalizer that treats dotted/nested layer-qualified keys uniformly. Touches config.py.

Acceptance: a loader function returns (paradigm, layers, recipes) for a new config and raises a clear error on a mixed config; old configs are detected and pass through unchanged.
notes:
Landed in src/winch/config.py + tests/test_config.py.

Public API for downstream tasks (winch-iua resolution, winch-lnz generation, etc.):
- config.parse(merged_config) -> (paradigm, layers, recipes); paradigm is 'old'|'new'.
- config.detect_paradigm(config) -> 'old'|'new' (raises ConfigError on mixed).
- config.ConfigError: raised on malformed/mixed config.
- Layer dataclass: name, vars(dict scalar defaults, may include explicit 'image'), provides(list[str]), requires(list[str]), body(str|None), containerfile(str|None).
- Recipe dataclass: name, recipe_base(list[str]), stack(list[str]), layer_vars(dict layer_name -> {var: value}).
- parse() also validates cross-refs: recipe_base names a known recipe, stack/layer_vars name known layers (cycle detection deferred to winch-iua).

cli.Main now exposes self.paradigm/self.layers/self.recipes; old Graph built only for old paradigm; ctx.obj.graph raises a clear ClickException on a new-paradigm config until winch recipe lands.

Note: TOML nests dotted keys, so 'spack.version=' and [recipe.r.spack] subtables arrive identically and are treated uniformly. test_podman.py failures in this env are environmental (no podman binary).
close_reason: Implemented config detection + layer/recipe parsing with tests (22 new, all passing).

title: winch2: recipe resolution and recipe_base inheritance
description:
Resolve a recipe (named or anonymous) into an ordered stack plus per-layer resolved variable maps. See doc/winch2-plan.md sections 12.3-12.5.

recipe_base (string or list-of-string) names other recipes. (1) Effective stack = concatenation of each base's fully-resolved stack in recipe_base order, then this recipe's own stack. Resolve bases recursively; detect and error on cycles. (2) Layer-variable resolution is last-wins: bases (in order) -> this recipe's layer-qualified vars -> CLI --set (highest precedence). Layer defaults from [layer.*] are the lowest precedence.

Anonymous recipe: a --stack list with empty recipe_base. Depends on the config parsing/normalizer from the config task. Likely lives in a new recipe.py module.

Acceptance: given recipes with single and multiple recipe_base entries plus overrides, the resolver yields the correct concatenated stack and final variable values; cycles raise a clear error.
notes:
Landed in src/winch/recipe.py + tests/test_recipe.py (22 tests).

Public API for winch-lnz (generation) and winch-ych (capabilities):
- recipe.resolve(layers, recipes, name=None, stack=None, sets=None) -> ResolvedRecipe. Exactly one of name (named [recipe.*]) or stack (anonymous --stack list). sets is an override map {layer:{var:val}} at highest precedence.
- ResolvedRecipe: .name, .stack (ordered layer names; may contain a name more than once for diamond inheritance — generator dedups by digest), .layer_vars (dict: layer name -> resolved var map = layer defaults overridden by recipe_base chain, recipe-level vars, then --set). Only stack layers get an entry.
- recipe.parse_set_overrides(['LAYER.VAR=VALUE', ...]) -> {layer:{var:val}}; splits on first '=' (values may contain '='); first '.' separates layer from var.

Precedence (low->high): Layer.vars defaults -> recipe_base recipes in order (recursively resolved) -> this recipe's layer_vars -> --set. Last-wins per (layer,var).

recipe_base cycles raise ConfigError ('cycle detected: a -> b -> a'); diamonds are valid (not cycles). Unknown recipe/stack-layer/--set-target raise ConfigError; wrong selector count raises ValueError.

Downstream generator pattern: for name in rr.stack -> use layers[name] for body/containerfile/provides/requires and rr.layer_vars[name] for variables.
close_reason: Implemented recipe.py resolver (recipe_base inheritance, last-wins var precedence, anonymous --stack, --set, cycle detection) with 22 tests.

title: winch2: document the new paradigm in README.org
description:
Document layers, recipes, capabilities, recipe_base inheritance, --set, digest image naming/labels, and the winch recipe/list/dot/render commands in README.org. See doc/winch2-plan.md section 12. Explain the old-vs-new paradigm split and that they are never mixed. Depends on the command work being in place.

Acceptance: README.org has a 'New paradigm' (layers/recipes) section with a worked example consistent with example/phlex2.toml.

title: winch2: new-paradigm example config
description:
Add example/phlex2.toml demonstrating the new paradigm end-to-end. See doc/winch2-plan.md sections 12.2-12.6 and 12.10.

Include: stand-alone [layer.*] fragments using body (no FROM); a base layer using the containerfile escape hatch (FROM debian:{release}); capabilities (provides/requires with a '|' OR); a named [recipe.*] using recipe_base inheritance and layer-qualified overrides. Mirror the intent of example/phlex.toml so the two paradigms can be compared. Verify it builds (or at least resolves+renders) via 'winch recipe'. Depends on the recipe command.

Acceptance: 'winch list' and 'winch dot' work on the example and 'winch recipe' resolves and validates it (build optional if podman/base images unavailable).

title: winch2: recipe-driven list, dot, and render commands
description:
Adapt list/dot/render to the new paradigm, driven by a recipe selector. See doc/winch2-plan.md section 12.9.

Add a shared recipe-selector helper (analogous to the old selection() decorator) accepting a positional recipe NAME or --stack/--set. winch list with NO selector lists defined [layer.*] and [recipe.*] tables; with a selector lists the resolved instance chain honoring -t/--template. winch dot emits GraphViz for the resolved chain(s) (no selector = union of all named recipes). winch render renders -T/-t templates over the resolved instances to -o. Each errors clearly on an old config. Touches cli.py. Depends on instance generation.

Acceptance: list/dot/render each work for a named recipe and an anonymous --stack, and bare 'winch list' enumerates layers and recipes.
notes:
Landed in src/winch/cli.py; tests in tests/test_inspect_cmd.py (10, no podman).

list/dot/render are now paradigm-aware (same command names, branch on ctx.obj.paradigm):
- New helpers in cli.py: old_select_options (adds -k/-d/-i), recipe_select_options (adds positional NAME, --stack, --set), and graph_and_inodes(ctx, kind, deps, instances, name, stack, sets, none_is_all=False) -> (graph, inodes). New paradigm builds via main.recipe_graph(name,stack_list,sets,validate=False) (no capability validation, so incompatible stacks can still be inspected) and orders nodes by nx.topological_sort; old paradigm uses select_inodes + main.graph.
- list: bare (new, no selector) prints 'layer <name>' and 'recipe <name>' lines; with NAME/--stack/--set prints the resolved chain honoring -t/--template. Old: -k/-d/-i as before.
- dot: NAME/--stack/--set selects chain(s); no selector = union of all named recipes (recipe_graph with name=None). Old: whole configured I-graph. Switched label formatting to format_map(SafeDict) (robust to missing keys).
- render: NAME/--stack/--set selector (no selector = all named recipes); -T/-t/-o as before.

Old-paradigm list/dot/render behavior is preserved (the new options are inert for old configs; old -k/-d/-i inert for new). dot/render to default /dev/stdout bypasses CliRunner capture -> tests use -o file.

For winch-3mf (README): document list/dot/render recipe-driven usage + 'winch recipe' build. Main.recipe_graph(name=,stack=,sets=,validate=) is the inspection entry point.
close_reason: list/dot/render adapted to be paradigm-aware (recipe NAME/--stack/--set selectors; bare list enumerates layers+recipes; dot union); old paradigm preserved; 10 tests.

title: winch2: podman image labeling and digest-tag support in build path
description:
Support attaching OCI labels and using digest-derived image tags when building. See doc/winch2-plan.md sections 12.2 (image naming) and 12.8.

The build must pass to 'podman build': --label winch.layer=<name>, --label winch.digest=<full digest>, --label winch.var.<KEY>=<VALUE> for each resolved layer variable, and optionally --label winch.provides=<comma-joined>. build_image already forwards extra args; add a small helper to construct the label arg list (and a tag helper only if it simplifies things). Touches podman.py and/or the build path. This is independent and can proceed in parallel.

Acceptance: a helper returns the correct --label argument list from an instance's resolved data; built images carry the labels (verifiable via podman inspect).
notes:
Landed: podman.label_args + podman.image_labels (src/winch/podman.py); graph.instance_labels + graph.INSTANCE_STRUCTURAL_KEYS (src/winch/graph.py). Tests: tests/test_labels.py (8, no podman) + tests/test_podman.py::test_build_with_labels (podman-gated, real build+inspect).

Public API for winch-xm4 (build command):
- podman.label_args(labels: dict) -> flat list ['--label','k=v',...] in sorted-key order; values stringified; no shell quoting (passed to podman as a list). build_image already forwards extra args.
- podman.image_labels(name) -> dict of an image's labels (via podman inspect); for verification.
- graph.instance_labels(node, idata, provides=()) -> winch.* label dict: winch.layer=idata['kind'], winch.digest=node (full digest), winch.var.<k>=value for each non-structural idata key, winch.provides=comma-joined (only if provides non-empty). provides must be passed ALREADY self-formatted.
- graph.INSTANCE_STRUCTURAL_KEYS = (kind, parent, containerfile, image) excluded from winch.var.*.

Build-command wiring pattern (winch-xm4): for each inode in build order: idata=graph.data(inode); kind=idata['kind']; prov=recipe._resolve_caps(layers[kind].provides, rr.layer_vars[kind]); build_image(idata['image'], cpath, *podman.label_args(graph.instance_labels(inode, idata, prov)), *extra_args). Note: build command iterates I-graph nodes whose ids ARE the full digests, so 'node' for instance_labels is the inode.

Digest-tag image naming itself was already implemented in winch-lnz (generation); no extra tag helper needed (build uses -t image).
close_reason: Implemented label_args/image_labels (podman.py) + instance_labels (graph.py) producing the section 12.8 winch.* labels; 8 unit tests + a podman-gated build+inspect test.

title: winch2: composable parent-free layers and recipes
description:
Add a new winch configuration paradigm in which container image layers are defined as stand-alone, parent-free '[layer.*]' fragments and composed into a build tree only at realization time via '[recipe.*]' tables (or an anonymous '--stack' on the CLI). This removes the need to bake the layer tree into config via 'parent_kind', enabling general composability.

The new paradigm coexists with the old one but is never mixed in a single run: a config is detected as old (bare kind tables with parent_kind, list-valued variants) or new (any [layer.*]/[recipe.*] table), and the appropriate code path runs.

Authoritative design spec: doc/winch2-plan.md, especially section 12 ('Resolved design — implementation spec'). That section wins over the earlier exploratory sections. Key decisions: no outer-product/list variants in the new paradigm; layer-variable override + recipe inheritance ('recipe_base', last-wins) instead; capabilities (provides/requires with exact-match and '|' OR alternation) validated before build; digest-based image names plus OCI labels for provenance; FROM injection for 'body' with 'containerfile' as the escape hatch; immediate-parent access only; new 'winch recipe' command plus recipe-driven list/dot/render.

All child tasks should read doc/winch2-plan.md section 12 before starting.
design: See doc/winch2-plan.md section 12 for the normative spec. Reuse util.self_format, util.digest, podman.py helpers, and the existing networkx I-graph (Graph.I) so that ipath/selection/build-ordering are shared. Keep the old Graph.initialize path intact; branch on detected paradigm.
